creature_text.Text: Another group! They can't keep coming forever... can they?
creature_text.comment: Жрица Летний Лепесток to Arbiter of the Inquisiiton

creature_text.Text: Look out! Greenies comin' fast! Grook 'em! Make this day their last!
creature_text.comment: Король обезьян to Arbiter of the Inquisiiton

creature_text.Text: I AM RENEWED! Come, little ones. Let us put an end to this invasion!
Heroes, your fight is with Korithis. I'll protect you from his winged monstrosity.
You have learned well how to fight these creatures, but this will be only one of many battles.
This is Fu Zan. Take it. May it shield you in the dark times ahead.
